title: Design: A/P Summary links are blue, semi-bold and not underlined
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with an open bill on today's date, so the report shows its name as a link.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • Open Work In Progress (Reports, then "Work In Progress" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, so its links can be compared.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the vendor names and compare them with the links on Work In Progress.
  2. Press Tab until a link has keyboard focus.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • They are blue, the same blue as the links on Work In Progress, semi-bold and not underlined.

Step 2:

  • The focused link is underlined.
  • Links are underlined only on keyboard focus.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11537 (Story 7, Document links open where they can)

  • S7-R7: “Links use the native report link style (the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline, underlined only on keyboard focus), readable in light and dark theme.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 2 "Export" (board Export.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p2-a-p-gets-the-same-menu.png: figure "A/P gets the same menu" (This build (after)), board "2. Export"

The design's own words:

  • "A/P Summary, Detail and Unpaid Invoices now export PDF and CSV. S3-R1." (caption of "A/P gets the same menu")

Difference from the PRD (DD-05), closed: PRD version 5 said "the same blue as Work In Progress, semi-bold, no underline" (S7-R7); the design shows document numbers and customer and vendor names are blue at the same (regular) weight as the plain text beside them. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 15): semi-bold, exactly as Work In Progress links look today; the design pictures will be corrected. This case follows the PRD (S7-R7, unchanged in version 9).
